data.name: Materia
data.detailed_description:
A Universe at War. A Future in Your Hands.

Materia is a sci-fi Action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, powerful loot, deep character progression, and long-term item hunting.

Humanity is fighting a losing war.

Across distant planets and shattered colonies, the Constructs continue their expansion. Once built to serve civilization, these machine forces have become something far more dangerous. Entire worlds have fallen. Cities have been abandoned. Survivors cling to what remains as the galaxy descends into chaos.

You are one of the few willing to fight back.

Travel across hostile worlds, battle through Construct-controlled territories, uncover lost technology, and grow stronger through powerful gear, skills, and character customization.

Every enemy defeated brings new rewards.
Every item found creates new possibilities.
Every planet pushes you deeper into the war.

Fight. Loot. Craft. Survive.

Fast-Paced Action RPG Combat

Engage in intense top-down combat against hostile machines, elite enemies, powerful bosses, and overwhelming enemy forces.

Build your character around your preferred playstyle and adapt as your equipment evolves.

  • Use powerful skills to dominate enemy groups.

  • Equip weapons and gear that enhance your build.

  • Combine offensive and defensive strategies.

  • Challenge increasingly dangerous encounters.


Discover new ways to play through itemization and progression.

The deeper you push, the greater the rewards.

A Loot Hunt Built for ARPG Fans

Materia is built around the pursuit of powerful items.

Discover weapons, armor, charms, jewels, and rare equipment capable of transforming your character. Whether you're searching for a perfect upgrade, a powerful unique item, or a rare crafting component, every drop has the potential to change your build.

Features include:

  • Magic, Rare, Unique, and Crafted items.

  • Powerful affix combinations.

  • Jewels and Charms with specialized bonuses.

  • Socketable equipment systems.

  • Build-defining itemization.

  • Rare chase items and endgame upgrades.

  • Crafting systems that create new paths to power.

Every enemy could drop something valuable.

Travel Across a Broken Galaxy

Explore a growing universe of dangerous planets, abandoned facilities, industrial wastelands, frozen frontiers, and Construct-controlled strongholds.

Each world presents unique challenges, enemies, and rewards as humanity struggles to reclaim territory from the machine threat.

  • Explore multiple planets and combat zones.

  • Fight through ruined cities and abandoned facilities.

  • Discover hidden paths and rewards.

  • Confront powerful bosses and elite enemies.

  • Uncover the remnants of a civilization at war.

The galaxy is vast. Survival is not guaranteed.

Create Your Own Build

Shape your character through equipment, skills, crafting, and progression choices.

Experiment with different combinations to create a build that matches your preferred playstyle.

Strengthen your character through:

  • Equipment upgrades.

  • Skill-enhancing gear.

  • Jewels and Charms.

  • Socketed items.

  • Crafting systems.

  • Resistance and survivability options.

  • Resource-focused builds.

  • Offensive and utility-focused combinations.

No two journeys need to be the same.

Built for the Long Haul

Materia is designed as a foundation for a growing sci-fi ARPG experience.

Future development is planned around expanding the universe, introducing new planets, increasing build variety, expanding itemization systems, adding new enemies and bosses, and delivering even more ways for players to chase power and customize their characters.

The war is only beginning.

Humanity Is Running Out of Time.

Wishlist Materia and join the fight against the Constructs.

​

                                                           It never forgets.

                                                            It never forgives.

data.short_description: Materia is a top-down sci-fi ARPG set in a vast, evolving galaxy. As a skilled Pilot, explore dangerous Rifts and Vaults, battle colossal World Bosses, and customize your character with the Cosmic Augmentation System. Team up or compete in PvP to shape the future of the Stellar Frontier.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-6100 / Core™ i5-2500K or AMD Ryzen™ 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 or AMD Radeon™ RX 470
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 64 Bit or Windows® 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600K / Core™ i7-4770 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
